https://github.com/rsms/inter/blob/master/LICENSE.txt

These files are the Inter Regular and Inter Medium static fonts. They are
bundled so Meridian looks the same on Windows, macOS, and Linux. The OFL
requirement that fonts remain under this license does not apply to documents
or images created with the fonts.
